capabilities: Add comment thread to Canvas element
Select text in Markdown note and choose Add comment
Keep multiple replies in the same thread
Highlight active commented text without changing the underlying document
disambiguation: It does not insert comment markup into the Markdown source files.
intentEvidence: Add anonymous, threaded comments to Obsidian Canvas elements, Canvas text selections, and selected text in Markdown notes.
problem: Users need a way to add discussions or annotations to specific parts of a note or canvas without altering the underlying content.
summary: Adds anonymous, threaded comments to Obsidian Canvas elements, selected text in Markdown notes, and Canvas text selections.
